question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales, t.calendar_year
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_year
),
city_growth AS (
    SELECT cs2019.cust_city
    FROM city_sales cs2019
    JOIN city_sales cs2020 ON cs2019.cust_city = cs2020.cust_city
    WHERE cs2019.calendar_year = 2019
      AND cs2020.calendar_year = 2020
      AND (1.0 * cs2020.total_sales / cs2019.total_sales - 1) >= 0.20
),
qualified_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_growth
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualified_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
product_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_year,
        product_total_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY calendar_year ORDER BY product_total_sales DESC) as rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY calendar_year) as cnt
    FROM product_sales
),
top_20_percent AS (
    SELECT prod_id, calendar_year, product_total_sales
    FROM product_ranked
    WHERE rn <= cnt * 0.20
),
product_yearly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_year,
        SUM(product_total_sales) as total_sales
    FROM top_20_percent
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_year
),
yearly_total AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        SUM(total_sales) as yearly_total
    FROM product_yearly_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_year
),
product_share AS (
    SELECT 
        pys.prod_id,
        pys.calendar_year,
        (1.0 * pys.total_sales / yt.yearly_total) as share
    FROM product_yearly_sales pys
    JOIN yearly_total yt ON pys.calendar_year = yt.calendar_year
),
products_both_years AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM product_share
    GROUP BY prod_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT calendar_year) = 2
),
product_share_with_change AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.prod_id,
        ps.calendar_year,
        ps.share,
        ps.share - LAG(ps.share) OVER (PARTITION BY ps.prod_id ORDER BY ps.calendar_year) as share_change
    FROM product_share ps
    WHERE ps.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM products_both_years)
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN share END) as share_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share END) as share_2020,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share_change END) as share_change
    FROM product_share_with_change
    GROUP BY prod_id, share_change
)
SELECT prod_id, share_2019, share_2020, share_change
FROM final_result
WHERE share_change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY share_change DESC
